sentences.text:
19.06.2023 Heard Mr. M A Sheikh, learned counsel for the petitioner as well as Mr. P. Borthakur,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam.
Issue Notice.
No formal notice is required to be issued on the respondent no. 1 as Mr. Borthakur has accepted notice on behalf of the said respondent.
Petitioner shall take steps for service of notice on the remaining respondents by registered post with A/D and other usual process.

Having heard the learned counsel for both the sides, till returnable date, further proceeding of Gauripur P.S. Case No. 741/2019 under Sections 417/342/376/323/34 IPC read with Section 4 of the POCSO Act shall remain stayed.
